verdict.rationale: First-party docs name an official 'Agents CLI' as one of four ways to manage ElevenLabs Agents, alongside the dashboard, API and hosted MCP server. The docs also show an npx-based skills install for AI coding assistants, but that is a skills installer rather than the CLI itself. The evidence is a single passing mention with no detail on commands, installation or workflows. Missing for 10: CLI installation and command documentation, description of agent create/configure/deploy workflows via the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works.
